notes.title: Mechanical Lab – 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
[u][b]Mechanical Lab – 1.0 Release Notes[/b][/u]

The long-awaited Mechanical Lab 1.0 update is here! This release brings  new content, gameplay improvements, and fixes to enhance your experience.

[b]New Features[/b]

-Added a new A6 robot/dog companion, which can be spawned in the Robot Market location.
-Introduced two new expedition types: Horde and Climbing, featuring a new enemy type.
-Expanded customization with new parts (Acid Launcher & Acid Ammo, Character Decorator Part, Energy Battery, Shields)
-Added gamepad (Xbox controller) support.
-Implemented a short text intro to introduce players to the game world.
-Added a new separate camera mode for vehicles.
-Introduced the ability to teleport vehicles, even during expeditions.
-Added a new town background.

[b]Improvements & Optimizations[/b]

-Enhanced background post-processing for better visuals.
-Improved game lighting.
-Updated tutorial vehicle thumbnails for clearer guidance.
-Increased crossbow bolt speed.
-Improved text objective visibility.
-Enhanced tutorial hints.
-Improved game radar visibility to make tracking objects easier.
-Added new radar icons for all in-game objects.
-Optimized memory usage for better performance.
-Refined robot attacking behavior.
-Updated all part thumbnails in the editor for better recognition.
-Improved A17 track physics for more realistic movement.
-Increased enemy shooting and vision range.
-Increased collectible spawn frequency.
-Balanced enemy robots' maximum health and weak points for better combat dynamics.
-Enhanced R24 texture quality.
-Reworked the third transport mission trolley.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

-Fixed a bug where destroyed trunks remained functional.
-Fixed a bug with the control station screen staying active after vehicle destruction.
-Fixed an issue where mines did not trigger properly.
-Fixed a bug where vehicle long jumps register when teleporting.
-Fixed the Destroyer achievement not tracking correctly.
-Fixed an issue where certain parts could not be destroyed.
-Fixed A17's magnet arm quivering unexpectedly.
-Fixed missing localizations for various parts.
-Fixed a lighting issue causing incorrect color and intensity for lamp parts.
-Fixed a bug where transport cargo disappeared.
-Fixed bullet reflection angle calculation errors.
-Fixed an issue where some vehicles teleported to incorrect positions.
-Fixed a bug that caused fire effects to log warnings.
-Fixed a bug where A18 parts detached incorrectly upon damage.

A huge thank you to all players for your support and feedback.

Stay tuned for even more exciting future features and improvements.

notes.title: Mechanical Lab 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
[h1]Mechanical Lab 1.0 launching on June 3, 2025![/h1]

The wait is almost over! Mechanical Lab is officially reaching its 1.0 version on [b]June 3, 2025[/b], bringing a wave of new features to enhance your robotic adventures.

Here are just some of the biggest changes coming in the update:
- Meet A6, your new robot-dog companion, available in the Robot Market
- New expedition types: Brace yourself for Horde and Climbing missions
- Gamepad support: Seamlessly play with your Xbox controller
- Expanded customization: parts including Acid Launcher, Acid Ammo, Shields, Energy Battery, and more
- A new text intro sets the stage for your journey
- A separate vehicle camera mode
- Improved mobility: Teleport vehicles even while on expeditions

[b]A full list of changes and fixes will be posted on the release day, so stay tuned for all the details.[/b]

Whether you're building, experimenting, or exploring, Mechanical Lab is taking its final shape—are you ready to dive in?

Stay tuned for more updates, and get ready for the ultimate robotic experience on June 3!

notes.title: Mechanical Lab Devlog – A6 Robot-Dog Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Mechanical Lab Devlog – A6 Robot-Dog Update [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767267/fec039aef2b7f010311d6c700016b26c594fb151.png[/img]

Hello, fellow engineers! Time for another Mechanical Lab devlog, and this one is particularly exciting. I've been working on an update that introduces a brand-new companion to the game—a highly advanced robot-dog named A6.

[h3]Meet A6 – Your Trusty Mechanical Sidekick[/h3]
A6 is designed to be more than just a loyal companion; he's an integral part of the player's journey through the game world. With precision engineering, this robotic canine will assist players in multiple ways:

Exploration – A6 can now accompany players on their travels, trotting alongside them as they navigate the landscapes of town.

Resource Gathering – No more manual scavenging! A6 will intelligently collect materials and deliver them straight to the player's vehicle, making survival and crafting more efficient.

Future Enhancements – This is just the beginning. In upcoming updates, A6 may evolve into a true guardian, capable of protecting the player from threats in the wild.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767267/f0ba71c2b795aa17afd44556ff60299b47c3b016.png[/img]

[h3]Development Progress[/h3]
I've been refining A6’s AI behavior, ensuring he feels like a true companion rather than just another tool. His movement, responsiveness, and interaction mechanics are shaping up nicely. Right now, I’m ironing out:

Pathfinding & Navigation – A6 needs to keep up with the player and traverse obstacles dynamically.

Resource Prioritization – Teaching him how to identify valuable resources and efficiently deliver them.

Animations & Sounds – Fine-tuning his movements so they feel organic, and adding satisfying mechanical whirrs.

That’s all for this devlog—stay tuned for more updates! Let me know what you think about A6 and what you'd love to see in future iterations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44767267/f5f31911830283b0c931524b15ac3c1b6c04a567.png[/img]

notes.title: Mechanical Lab 0.77 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Mechanical Lab 0.77

Hello, update focusing on vehicle editor improvements

Patch notes: 
-Added interactive vehicle building tutorial mode
-Added 10 vehicle schemes for tutorial building

-Added functionality to replace pipe type without removing connected parts
-Added the ability to insert pipes into other pipes
-Added the ability to duplicate a built vehicle
-Added the ability to save separate input data for each vehicle
-Added the ability to move parts without disconnecting the wiring
-Added an indicator of the influence of the power parameter to the energy and heat parameters
-Added the ability to save and reset changes to part parameters directly in the real-time vehicle settings window
-Added display of predicted values ​​of energy production and consumption, emissions and heat cooling

-2 new expeditions have been added
-Added a jet engine for jumping part
-Added battery part

-Fixed an issue with the robot's movement sound getting stuck after entering the vehicle or vehicle editor
-Added proper simulation of the robot's weight in the control station
-Fixed an issue with springs not working when placed next to each other
-Fixed an issue with incorrect display of texts in vehicle settings
-Improved lighting in the vehicle editor
-Improved the vehicle editor mesh effect
-Improved town loading time

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Mechanical Lab 0.76.3 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello, small update with bug fixes and gameplay improvements

Patch notes:
-Fixed some rooftop graphics not displaying correctly during expeditions
-Fixed an issue where the player was wounded by an enemy who died immediately after being shot
-Added smooth teleportation of player and vehicle without resetting the environment
-Added the ability to quickly teleport to the start of the expedition
-The behavior of the A4 drone has been improved so that it does not fly to a height beyond the camera's reach
-Fixed a bug that prevented from completing the objective directly from the vehicle
-Fixed a bug that caused camera shake to activate on explosions even far outside the camera's range
-Fixed an issue that caused a vehicle to disappear when left on one of the expedition buildings. A vehicle left in an expedition district now remains until the next expedition is launched

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Mechanical Lab 0.76.2 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello, a small update with corrections mainly based on reported feedback and bugs.

Patch notes: 
-Added the ability to reset the vehicle position with the "R" shortcut without opening the vehicle settings window
-Improved vehicle reset mechanics to increase the chance of getting out of a sticky situation
-Fixed an issue that caused enemies to attack the vehicle while editing
-Incorrect parameters of the fundamental part gearbox have been removed
-Interaction time with held buttons has been sped up
-Added the ability to quickly enter a vehicle after editing (disabled by default) - this behavior can be changed in the editor settings tab in the main settings menu
-Added warning about possible missing cable connections (enabled by default) - this warning can be changed in the editor settings tab in the main settings menu

In the meantime I'm working on an big update with major editor improvements, new parts, challenges and some new expeditions.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Mechanical Lab 0.76.1 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello, the first update mainly contains bug and stability fixes.

Mechanical Lab 0.76.1
-Fixed an issue with being able to re-enter the initial socket at the beginning of the game
-The display of part operating parameter values ​​has been improved to be more accurate
-Fixed an issue where the interactive wheel could be rotated in the wrong direction
-Improved the vehicle launch function after editing which caused an issue with some vehicles
-Fixed an issue with vehicle notifications being too frequent
-Fixed a bug with incorrect display of info and confirm windows

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Early Access Launch
notes.notes: It's now! Mechanical Lab is launching in Early Access. For 7 days only, the game will be available at a special promotional price. Thank you all for your support. As a solo developer, I tried to make your time spent with the game the best it could be. I hope you have as much fun as I had working on this project.
